# Glossary
This page contains most slang terms you might encounter on the station.
## AOS Arrest on sight.
## AHelp/Admin Help A relay used to report rulebreaking behavior or other issues to administrators.
## Atmos Short for Atmospherics.
## Bolted An airlock that is stuck open or closed, and will remain so until it is unbolted. Often these have solid red lights on them.
## Brig Effectively the jail in security, where prisoners are brought and held for their punishment.
## Crit/Critical Refers to the dying health state at which you fall unconscious and unable to move. Soft Crit can be used to refer to the period where you can crawl but will soon fall into a full critical state.
## Emag The cryptographic sequencer. "Emagged" usually refers to airlocks or lockers that are bolted open due to this.
## Insuls Short for Insulated Gloves. These are the yellow gloves most often worn by Engineers, which grant immunity to electric shocks.
## KOS Kill on sight.
## Mats Materials. Usually steel, plastic, plasteel, glass.
## QM Short for Quartermaster.
## Robust A word used to describe someone who is particularly adept in combat, or endured through a tough fight.
## Sec / Secoff Short for Security / Security Officer
## Shift In-Character way to refer to rounds.
## Spacing An event which causes an area to lose air pressure, i.e. a hull breach.
## Worms The Parasite organization.
